answer: One concrete defense is to make reputation a costly, earned asset rather than a free label. A newcomer starts with no trust: to participate it must post a small bond and complete verifiable work, like checking a timber supply record, with results graded by unrelated peers. Honest work builds a crystal-clear public history anyone can inspect, while a fake identity has none. Sybil copies cannot fake this history cheaply, and when one misbehaves its reputation echoes across the network, so its bond is slashed and the attacker loses more than one fake identity could ever gain.
